description: This is the team for the game Luner Lifeline
summary:
Lunar Lifeline is an interactive Scratch survival game that puts players in charge of saving a lunar outpost. Players explore interconnected rooms, manage limited oxygen, repair essential systems, recover 20 artefacts and rescue five injured astronauts. Each patient requires a single-use medical pack, making careful planning essential.

A scientist provides mission guidance, while a toolkit speeds up repairs and a satchel increases carrying capacity. Sprinting helps players move faster but consumes extra oxygen. After completing their objectives, players launch their spacecraft and navigate hazards on the journey home.

Designed for young learners, the game uses simplified space survival scenarios to develop problem-solving, prioritisation and resource-management skills.
